featured_reviews.name: Tasneem Chougle
featured_reviews.review_text:
Hummingbirds is the best choice we made for our son. They have taken very good care of children and make it a very fun comfortable place. Everything from quality of education to hygiene is great. All the faculties were very loving and caring.
The play school is huge involving spacious open classrooms and play area. Their play lead learning and Montessori approach is commendable. My son has learned loads and loved his school. I would really recommend it to everyone and special thanks to Vinitha teacher for being my son's guiding angel.

featured_reviews.name: Oruge Hassan
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a wonderful experience with Hummingbird School during my daughter’s nursery year. It is truly a nurturing and engaging environment for young children. My daughter absolutely loved going to school every day, which says a lot about how happy and comfortable she felt there.

The school puts great emphasis on each child individually, ensuring that every child is seen, heard, and encouraged. What impressed me the most was their “learning by doing” approach, which made education fun, interactive, and meaningful for the kids.

Their creative theme days like Community Day, Farmers Day, Circus Day, Senses Day, and many more were thoughtfully planned and executed. These activities not only made learning enjoyable but also helped children understand real-life concepts in a practical way.

I truly appreciate the effort, dedication, and love the teachers and staff put into shaping young minds. It has been a delightful journey for both my daughter and me. I would highly recommend this school to any parent looking for a strong and joyful foundation for their child.

featured_reviews.name: Zeenat Siddiqui
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have been studying at Hussain Allana English School from 1 yr , and overall my experience has been very positive. The teachers are hardworking, supportive, and always encourage students to improve academically and personally. The school provides a good learning environment, and many activities are organized throughout the year that help students develop confidence, creativity, and teamwork skills.

The staff members are kind and helpful, and they make efforts to ensure that students receive a quality education. The school also maintains discipline and motivates students to participate in various educational and extracurricular activities.

However, I would like to suggest a few improvements. It would be helpful if the school administration could regularly check the benches and desks in classrooms. Some students have written inappropriate words and drawings on them, which does not create a good classroom environment. We understand that this is not the school's fault, as it is the responsibility of students to take care of school property, but regular inspections and cleaning could help address the issue.

Additionally, some benches are slightly damaged or broken and may need repair or replacement to ensure students can sit comfortably and safely during classes.

Apart from these concerns, I appreciate the efforts of the teachers and staff in providing a good education. With a little more attention to classroom furniture and maintenance, the school can become even better. Thank you to all the teachers and staff for their dedication and hard work.

featured_reviews.name: Salman Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
i came to mumbai as a gcc transfer student from kuwait and honestly, everything was very new for me. i was earlier studying ibdp subjects, but by year 12 i realised it was becoming too difficult for me and i was worried that i might lose my academic year.

after counselling at rims i understood that i still had a way to save my year and continue with subjects that matched my future plans. they guided me properly and helped me choose general english, business, environmental management and IT however that i could complete my ALevels and move ahead towards a bba programme.

this really gave me relief because i did not have to waste one full year. i completed my a levels, received my certificates and now i am doing my bba programme. i also feel more confident because the bba pathway includes practical learning, public speakings, AI and internship exposure, which will help me before going for my masters in switzerland.

mumbai was completely new for me but rims made the transition easier. i feel relaxed and thankful that i found the right guidance at the right time.

featured_reviews.name: Bina Shah
featured_reviews.review_text: Gives better facilities I still remember when my daughter Bina was looking for a flexible international BBA programme. We explored several options but choosing RIMS turned out to be one of the best decisions we made. What really stood out was the opportunity to gain practical experience through internships while pursuing her BBA. This was very important for her future plans as she always wanted to continue with an MBA in countries like new zealand the UK or Scotland. Throughout her journey the support and guidance she received were excellent. Today Bina is preparing to move to new zealand in 2028 to take the next step in her academic journey and we are grateful for the role RIMS played in helping her achieve this goal. Thank you once again for your guidance and support – Parent of Bina

featured_reviews.name: Sunita Dubey
featured_reviews.review_text:
rims international school & junior college has been a very reassuring experience for us. my son dhruv was earlier studying at gems school in dubai, UAE so as a middle east gcse british transfer parent i had a lot of questions and worries about how he would adjust to the cambridge pathway in mumbai.
now that the 2026 academic year is over, i can honestly say the school supported us well. we had doubts about a levels, ib options, subject choices and university eligibility, especially because dhruv was looking at international universities like king’s college london.
dhruv is from the science stream with english, physics, chemistry and computer science. the team & faculties at rims guided us patiently and helped us understand the right direction after igcse and for his year 13 / a2 level planning.
thank you to the rims team for supporting dhruv during this important stage. i would genuinely recommend the school to parents looking for cambridge igcse, as & a level guidance, science stream counselling, middle east transfer support and international university pathway guidance in mumbai.
